mcq.q: Which component is responsible for the actual display in a computer?
mcq.e: VRAM stores the image and the GPU computes it, but the cathode-ray tube generates the visible output.

mcq.q: In a CRT, which part regulates the intensity (brightness) of the electron beam?
mcq.e: The control grid controls beam intensity; the anodes shape and speed the beam.

mcq.q: On a CRT, the maximum number of points that can be displayed without overlap is called
mcq.e: That is resolution. Persistence is how long the phosphor glows.

mcq.q: Which scanning method operates like a pencil, drawing the line image directly on the screen?
mcq.e: Random scan draws lines directly; raster scan sweeps pixel by pixel, row by row.

mcq.q: Commercial motion pictures use 24 frames per second. How many screen illuminations per second does this give?
mcq.e: Each frame is flashed three times to avoid flicker: 24 x 3 = 72.

mcq.q: Which of the following display devices is NOT emissive?
mcq.e: An LCD modulates a backlight instead of emitting light; plasma, electroluminescent and LED displays emit their own light.

mcq.q: A frame buffer storing multiple bits per pixel is called a
mcq.e: One bit per pixel gives a bitmap; multiple bits per pixel give a pixmap.

mcq.q: A widescreen monitor has height 4 inches and aspect ratio 3 : 2. What is its width?
mcq.e: width = height x ratio = 4 x 3/2 = 6 inches.

mcq.q: An image is 4 inches wide with aspect ratio 3 : 2. What is its height?
mcq.e: height = width / ratio = 4 x 2/3 = 8/3 inch.

mcq.q: Height of a picture is 4.5 inches and its aspect ratio is 1.5. What is its width?
mcq.e: width = 4.5 x 1.5 = 6.75 inches.

mcq.q: A 512 x 512 pixel image is printed 2 x 2 inches. What is its resolution in pixels per inch?
mcq.e: Resolution = pixels / inches = 512 / 2 = 256 ppi.

mcq.q: A 640 x 480 picture uses 256 colours. Approximately what is its uncompressed size?
mcq.e: 256 colours = 8 bits = 1 byte per pixel; 640 x 480 x 1 = 307,200 bytes, about 300 KB.

mcq.q: The uncompressed bit rate of 800 x 600 pixel video, 8 bits per pixel, at 40 frames per second is
mcq.e: 800 x 600 x 8 x 40 = 153,600,000 bps = 153.6 Mbps, which is why MPEG compression is needed.

mcq.q: The CMY equivalent of the RGB colour (0.2, 1, 0.5) is
mcq.e: CMY = 1 - RGB, giving (0.8, 0, 0.5).

mcq.q: The RGB equivalent of the CMY colour (0.25, 0.65, 0) is
mcq.e: RGB = 1 - CMY, giving (0.75, 0.35, 1).

mcq.q: In digitising an image, which process digitises the amplitude value?
mcq.e: Sampling picks the positions; quantization digitises the amplitude.

mcq.q: In the standard digital image processing pipeline, which step comes right after compression?
mcq.e: Morphological processing is the step that follows compression.

mcq.q: Which bit depth is NOT supported by the BMP format?
mcq.e: BMP supports 1/4/8/16/24/32-bit depths; 128-bit is not supported.

mcq.q: Which CSS rule makes images fully grey?
mcq.e: The function grayscale() is used on the filter property, unquoted.

mcq.q: 'High color' images use how many bits per pixel?
mcq.e: High color is 16 bpp (65,536 colours); 8-bit gives 256 colours and 24-bit is true colour.

mcq.q: Which image format is lossy and best suited to photographs?
mcq.e: JPEG is a lossy raster format; PNG and TIFF are lossless and SVG is vector.

mcq.q: Which format is the odd one out because it is NOT a graphics format?
mcq.e: WAV is an audio format.

mcq.q: Which Photoshop tool duplicates part of an image to another area, used for blemish or object removal?
mcq.e: Clone Stamp duplicates part of the image to another area.

mcq.q: Which tool in Flash is the easiest way to draw a heptagon?
o: PolyStar tool with Polygon style set to 7 sides
mcq.e: PolyStar with the Polygon style and seven sides draws a heptagon.

mcq.q: Which of these is a multimedia authoring tool for creating interactive presentations?
mcq.e: Authoring tools combine media into interactive presentations; Word and Photoshop edit a single medium.

mcq.q: Animation basically refers to
o: Simulated motion pictures showing movement of drawn objects
mcq.e: Animation is a pictorial presentation of simulated motion of drawn objects.

mcq.q: Which typography term adjusts the space between characters?
mcq.e: Kerning is spacing between characters; leading is between lines.

mcq.q: The MPEG standard is primarily a specification of the
mcq.e: MPEG fixes the bitstream the decoder accepts, leaving encoders free.

mcq.q: The macroblock layer in MPEG consists of how many pixels?
mcq.e: A macroblock is 16 x 16 pixels (four 8 x 8 DCT blocks).

mcq.q: A Bezier curve is defined by a minimum of how many points?
mcq.e: It needs an origin, an endpoint and at least one control point, so three.

mcq.q: Which is NOT a parameter on which lighting is based?
mcq.e: Lighting depends on source, surface and observer; the rendering algorithm only computes the result.

mcq.q: Which statement about the Z-buffer algorithm is INCORRECT?
o: It is an image-space visible-surface method
It uses a depth buffer plus a refresh buffer
It finds one visible surface per pixel
Object edges can be anti-aliased by the basic algorithm
mcq.e: The basic Z-buffer cannot anti-alias edges; the other three statements are true.

mcq.q: Scaling triangle vertex B(3,3) by factor 2 in x and 4 in y gives
mcq.e: Scaling multiplies each coordinate: (3x2, 3x4) = (6,12).

mcq.q: Rotating a quarter-circle of radius 1 through 360 degrees about the X-axis, the curved surface area of the solid is
mcq.e: The solid is a hemisphere with curved area 2 pi r^2 = 2 pi.

mcq.q: Which is a line CLIPPING algorithm?
mcq.e: Liang-Barsky clips lines; the others draw lines.

mcq.q: A circle has how many-way symmetry, exploited by circle-drawing algorithms?
mcq.e: One computed octant point gives seven reflections, so eight-way.

mcq.q: In Cohen-Sutherland clipping with window (-3,1)-(2,6), the 4-bit TBRL region code of P(-4,2) is
mcq.e: P lies to the left of the window, so only the Left bit is set: 0001.

mcq.q: Aliasing (jagged edges) is reduced by
mcq.e: Anti-aliasing is low-pass filtering: blurring cuts high frequencies.

tf.s: Aspect ratio is the ratio of height to width.
tf.n: Aspect ratio is width : height, width first; widescreen standard is 16 : 9.

tf.s: 1 bit per pixel in a frame buffer gives a bitmap.
tf.n: Multiple bits per pixel give a pixmap.
Each CMY component is one minus the matching RGB component, and vice versa.
PNG is lossless raster and supports transparency.

tf.s: SVG is a raster graphic format.
tf.n: SVG is a vector format of mathematical shapes that scales without loss.

tf.s: The vanishing point appears in parallel projection.
tf.n: It is a perspective-projection property where parallel lines converge.

tf.s: Digitization uses both sampling and quantization.
tf.n: Sampling picks positions and quantization digitises amplitude.

tf.s: Temporal compression in MPEG removes redundant frames.
tf.n: Successive frames repeat, so only differences are sent.

tf.s: Point, area and text clipping are all types of clipping.
tf.n: Clipping keeps the visible portion and discards the invisible one.

tf.s: The Joystick is a controller held with both hands.
tf.n: A joystick is a handle on a base; the game pad is held in both hands.
